title.narrative: Annual updates to data on over 450 indicators and more than 60 indices for the period of 20232026 and for 68 target countries. Data is made available on the VDem website.

description.narrative: In the short and medium term, EU Institutions, EU Delegations, and EU Member States, as well as key actors in the Team for Democracy (TED) and others active in the field of democracy support will have gained a deeper understanding and will be able to directly inform their decision making in relation to democracy support interventions.

title.narrative: Annually updated VDem Data on over 450 indicators and more than 60 indices

description.narrative: Data on over 450 indicators and more than 60 indices of democracy, human rights, civil society, and related areas, is completely updated each year, for the period of 20232026, for the 68 target countries, and is publicly available on the VDem website and to the EU institutions and its partners. The data is updated annually.

title.narrative: Strengthened public awareness and debate of democracy.

description.narrative: The Actions will significantly enhance our knowledge base on democratic developments in the 68 targeted countries and deepen our understanding on the dividends of democracy across the world. Democratic support and development have a direct relevance to a number of cross cutting issues including gender equality, human rights, good governance, support to youth, childrens rights and indigenous peoples, environmental sustainability, combating HIV/AIDS.
